entities.name: Levitical Priesthood
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The hereditary priesthood of ancient Israel, descended from Aaron and the tribe of Levi. Responsible for sacrifice, Torah instruction, and maintenance of the Tabernacle/Temple. The high priest alone could enter the Holy of Holies on the Day of Atonement.
